name: @cloudsforge/community
description: Communities and governance. Communities, membership, roles, treasury accounts, proposals, discussion, votes, delegations, timelocks and executions. A governance system moves money by vote, so this service holds no money — a treasury account is a micro-ledger account and a spend is a ledger entry — a member's voting power is counted exactly once by a unique constraint, a delegation cycle is refused by a trigger, a timelock is enforced by the database rather than by a handler, and a passed proposal executes exactly once under a lease keyed on the proposal.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: every database test file truncates this service's tables between cases, and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01). Cases within a file already run in order.

_localDependencies: Every sibling takes 'link:', not 'file:'. A 'file:' path PACKS the dependency, and each of
these packages declares files: ['dist'] with a publishConfig that points main/types at dist/.
Packing therefore installs a package whose exports resolve to a dist/ that has not been built.
'link:' symlinks the checkout in place, so the working-tree manifest is the one that is read.
@cloudsforge/contracts-chain is here for ONE mapping: a gate's numeric chain id to the slug
micro-indexer puts in a path. On publish it takes an EXACT pin ('1.0.0') and never a caret,
for the reason its own header gives — wallet, settlement, custody and indexer must agree
byte-for-byte about which chain a number names and at what depth money is credited.
